initial.chief_complaint: Worsening left upper abdominal pain with nausea and vomiting.

presenting_complaint: Worsening left upper abdominal pain with nausea and vomiting.
history_freetext:
Left upper quadrant pain began mildly about eight days earlier. Treated as gastroenteritis without improvement; now worse with nausea and vomiting.
Amenorrhea and positive home urine pregnancy test; approximately five weeks gestation by dates, gravida 1 para 0.
No reported chronic medical or surgical disease, pelvic inflammatory disease, tobacco or alcohol use.
